mentions.name: MeshLive
mentions.description: Open-source app for voice/video calls and livestreaming over Bluetooth mesh without internet, with nearby phones relaying to extend range. Available on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows, with live video working over BLE.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on MeshLive, an open-source app for voice/video calls and livestreaming over Bluetooth mesh without internet. Nearby phone relay to extend the range.
mentions.author: gptgautam1
